iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.desc: Rust-red rock from the Furnace Coast pits. Smelt it with coal.

iron_ingot.name: Iron Ingot
iron_ingot.desc: Bar iron. The bones of every machine and most blades.

brass_ingot.name: Brass Ingot
brass_ingot.desc: Copper and zinc. Springs, gears and fittings.

copper_wire.name: Copper Wire
copper_wire.desc: A coil of drawn copper. Galvanics eats it by the mile.

hardwood_plank.name: Hardwood Plank
hardwood_plank.desc: Seasoned walnut or ash. Stocks, hafts and handles.

leather_strip.name: Leather Strip
leather_strip.desc: Tanned hide cut for grips and straps.

coal_lump.name: Coal
coal_lump.desc: Furnace Coast coal. Every forge, boiler and smelter runs on it. Magic has no use for it.

glass_blank.name: Glass Blank
glass_blank.desc: A disc of clear glass, ready for grinding.

saltpetre.name: Saltpetre
saltpetre.desc: Scraped from cellar walls and dung heaps. Half of black powder.

sulphur.name: Sulphur
sulphur.desc: Yellow and stinking. The other half of black powder.

black_resin.name: Black Resin
black_resin.desc: Fen pine pitch. Glue, caulk and fuse coating.

river_salt.name: River Salt
river_salt.desc: Grey salt panned from meltwater. Used by alchemists and galvanists alike.

lantern_moss.name: Lantern Moss
lantern_moss.desc: Glows faintly where Resonance is high. Healers and priests prize it.

frostcap.name: Frostcap
frostcap.desc: A blue mushroom that only grows on old ice. Distils into frost essence.

emberroot.name: Emberroot
emberroot.desc: A root that stays warm in snow. Distils into ember essence.

frost_essence.name: Frost Essence
frost_essence.desc: Captured cold in a stoppered vial. Binds frost enchantments.

ember_essence.name: Ember Essence
ember_essence.desc: A vial that never cools. Binds fire enchantments.

storm_essence.name: Storm Essence
storm_essence.desc: Crackles against the glass. Drawn from places lightning keeps striking.

ward_essence.name: Ward Essence
ward_essence.desc: Thick and pale. Binds protective glyphs.

lantern_essence.name: Lantern Essence
lantern_essence.desc: Spring water from a living shrine, blessed and sealed. Divine work only.

tinker_kit.name: Tinker's Kit
tinker_kit.desc: Files, pliers, a jeweller's screwdriver and a tin of oil. Needed for Gear schematics.

smith_hammer.name: Smith's Hammer
smith_hammer.desc: Cross-peen hammer and tongs. Needed for smithing recipes (a forge or campfire will do in the prototype).

field_alembic.name: Field Alembic
field_alembic.desc: A folding still with copper coils. Needed for herbalism and essence distilling.

etching_stylus.name: Etching Stylus
etching_stylus.desc: A silver-tipped stylus for cutting glyphs. Needed for every enchantment.
